notes.title: Master Pyrox to become freeware, Update 1.3.2 released
notes.notes:
Greeting, fellow Pyromancers!
Four years after the game's release, we're planning to make the game free to play for everyone. This change will happen within a week.
And as a thank you for all those who have supported us in the past and bought the game on Steam, we're releasing a brand new update today! Update 1.3.2 includes a couple of bugfixes, improved performance and improvements to the built-in levels. And this won't be the final version, we have at least one more update planned.

notes.title: Master Pyrox Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow pyromancers!

Today we're releasing our first little update for the game. It comes with the following new features and changes:
 
    Added a zoomed-in camera mode that follows the player in singleplayer and network games
    Added a new achievement
    Fixed a few minor graphical glitches
    Optimised some light and material settings.
    Updated the German translation

We have plans for bigger content updates in the future: updated maps, new bosses, new objects... so stay tuned, and if you have any ideas for features you'd like to see in the game, let us know!

Denis
